m: Wrap a *blanket* tight around a hissing *cobra*, tie it with string, and post the **parcel** quickly.
A *big man* stands under a wooden *archway* that rests across his shoulders: an ox's **yoke**.
One *kneeling man* faces another *kneeling man*, and their shapes slot together like a **mortise**.
Draw back the *curtains*, pick up the *knife*, and everyone gets a slice of **cut cake**.
One *mouth* beside another *mouth*, both talking at once and nobody listening: endless **chatter**.
A *pole axe* chops open a *covered mouth* of a barrel full of white **salt**.
A *mouth* calls out from between two *curtains* of reeds, but only one bird answers: a **lone bird**.
A *helping hand* grabs the *pawn* by the neck of his shirt: a rough **collar grab**.
Under an *archway* a square *mouth* opens to let the light in: a **window**.
Under *icicles* outside the shop, the people waiting *yawn* one after another: a long **queue**.
A *scholar* opens his *mouth* to bless you and hands you a **lucky charm**.
Under an *archway* of metal plates a knight's chest is covered: his **armour**.
A *standing person* bends over into a *spoon* shape and becomes something else: a **shape-shifter**.
A *person* stands between two families, passing messages back and forth: the **go-between**.
Hang strips over the *hurdle* to dry under the *sun* for days: **sun-dried meat**.
A *person* uses a *spoon* to line everything up in rows: a **neat stack**.
A *cow head* bobs in front as its *legs* race ahead of the herd: the **front runner**.
The *grass* swallows the sun as it sinks between the stalks: **sunset**.
Under the *sun* the *cloaked beggar* asks, why? how? when? Every word is a **question mark**.
Under a *tent* of leaves, carve out a log with a *moon sickle*: a **dugout canoe**.
On top of the *tree*, a round *rice field* of skin hangs heavy: ripe **fruit**.
A *person* ducks under the *archway* and steps through to the **inner room**.
A *standing person* counts notes with a quick *thumb* at the till: the **cashier**.
A *person* lifts the lid after the party: plenty of **leftovers** for tomorrow.
Bite a *chili*, blaze a trail through the jungle, and go where no one has been: a **pioneer**.
With his *right hand* on a *leaning cliff*, he pushes it over against the king: a **rebel**.
Nail a flat board over the *door* with the family name painted on: the **nameboard**.
Tie a *hairpin* to a *fishing line*, lower it to the river god: an **offering**.
From the *podium* you see a *bare tree* that held up your family: your **parents**.
Under the government *roof* a man uses a *scoop* to take his share: an **official**.
A *person* and a *bowing man* stack sacks of grain under one roof: the village **barn**.
A *cow head* puts its *mouth* to a trumpet and bellows the news: the **announcer**.
Open the *curtains* and push your *elbow* through the crowd: the busy **town square**.
A *hairpin* spins on the floor, winding yarn round and round: a **spindle**.
A *person* opens the lid and a *king* stares out of the **treasure chest**.
Show your *elbow* stamp and your *legs* are allowed to pass: you have a **permit**.
A *person* lifts the cloth and stares sadly at a bowl of cold rice: **old food**.
Heat a turtle shell until cracks run out like *legs* across it: a **cracked shell**.
Two *horns* of rock rise into the *sky*, with one narrow road between: the **mountain pass**.
Walk round the *rice field* and back to the *mouth* where you began: a full **circuit**.
Draw a *bow* and shoot two lines down through it: a **dollar sign**.
A *cliff* overhangs a *bowing man* who cannot stand up: a **trapped man**.
Lay out dish after dish until the *child* can eat no more: a **feast**.
*Flowing locks* and stiff *bristles* blow round the horse's neck: its thick **mane**.
A *bent knife* cuts the dry grass, a *comb* rakes it into piles: **hay**.
Under the *lid* of your chin, a collar stands stiff as a *small table*: a **high collar**.
A wide-open *mouth* on a stiff *tree* trunk, not moving: a **blank stare**.
Plant a *cross* flag and hammer tent pegs with a *root hook*: set up **camp**.
A *cross* of handle and a round paper top swishing back and forth: a **fan**.
A *strong arm* and a *mouth* side by side add up together: the **plus sign**.
A *child* carries a parent with *grey hair* on his back: a **dutiful son**.
A *woman* sits under the *roof*, the door locked: a **safe home**.
Wind up a *spool* of wire to a *mouth* and sound blasts out: a **speaker**.
A *big man* lies stretched out inside a *fence* of straw: his **sleeping mat**.
Pile one *mountain* right on top of another *mountain* and climb both: a **double mountain**.
Your *left hand* holds up a joint under the *moon*: you are **holding meat**.
A *lying man* rests on an *antique* bed in his own **house**.
A *mouth* of a shade with a *towel* of cord hanging down: a **hanging lamp**.
*Trudging feet* in the snow, *two sparks* of frost on the sleeve: a thick **winter coat**.
Raised high on a *tall stool* above everyone, the old ruler: the **emperor**.
A *big man* with a *nodding head* walks backwards wearing socks on his ears: an **oddball**.
Pull an *open crate* of papers and cut out the town with *scissors*: a **district map**.
Stack bamboo baskets over boiling water until the *sun* is hidden by the mist: a **steamer**.
Hang a weight from a *cross* and the string drops dead straight: a **plumb line**.
A *helping hand* clicks shut on your wrist, small as a *pill*: a pair of **handcuffs**.
Under the *dusk moon* a *bowing man* curls up and turns all night: a **tossing sleeper**.
Pin the notice to the *seedbed* gate with your *thumb* so the whole village reads it: a **proclamation**.
Your *left hand* holds the bowl, and the other hand lifts a spoon to your *mouth*: the **feeding hand**.
A *mouth* calls for help and a *strong arm* hands over a new bolt: a **spare part**.
One *dusk moon* rises after another *dusk moon*, night after night: **many moons**.
A *skeleton* and a *standing knife* stand side by side with the others: the police **lineup**.
Stack one *campfire* right on top of another *campfire* and they roar up into a **blaze**.
Dip the *spoon* into ink, seal it under the *sun*, unroll it: the **edict scroll**.
Look through the *cross*-hairs at a tiny screw in the *toolbox*: a **magnifying glass**.
A pair of *antlers* tied over two bundles of wheat in one hand: **two sheaves**.
A *mouth*, another *mouth* and a third *mouth* all want to taste the **goods**.
Put a *cross* price tag on every *shopping basket* and shout to buyers: a **market stall**.
*Animal tracks* run all over the muddy *rice field*: a **footprint field**.
Under an *archway* of plates lie little squares of *soil*: a **tortoise shell**.
A strong *hand* raises a long *halberd* and steps proudly to the front: the **spearman**.
Under the stadium *roof* a gold *yuan coin* waits for the runner who crosses the **finish line**.
Put an *archway* handle on a *covered mouth* cup, then make a second one: a **matching cup**.
Turn an *open crate* on its side and trace a right angle along it: a **set square**.
Behind a desk, a small man trims forms with *scissors* and stamps them one by one: the **clerk**.
An *antique* in one hand, a *cane* in the other: the old **storyteller** begins.
A *woman* waits beside the *podium* to serve the lady: her **handmaid**.
A *kneeling man* at the gate raps the brass *mouth* of the **door knocker**.
Lift the *lid*, show your *permit*, and blow it up until it floats: a **balloon**.
A whining *bug* with a needle *mouth* bites your arm at night: a **mosquito**.
A long trunk curling like a *bent knife* above huge feet: an **elephant**.
Open your *mouth* and kneel before the *king* to hand over your **petition**.
Below the *moon* of your ribs, above a *tombstone* of a belly: the **diaphragm**.
A *lying man* rests while a *spoon* stirs her soup in the convent: the quiet **nun**.
A *standing person* lifts a tiny *child* lion up into the air: a playful little **cub**.
Stand on the *palace* steps in the *sun* and look out over the **landscape**.
Your *left hand* clasps someone's *right hand* and shakes it: a good **friend**.
A *torn net* hangs over a *tree* at the mouth of a dark **deep cave**.
An *archway* in the roof with bright panes letting in light: a **skylight**.
A *swarm* of fans lifts the *halberd*-handled gold cup: the winner's **trophy**.
Grab a *bundle* of recruits and wave a *cane* while barking orders: the **drill sergeant**.
A *person* picks up something to help with the job: a handy **tool**.
Pull an *open crate* off the shelf and lift out a golden *halberd*: a **ceremonial axe**.
The *town crier* stands in the *sun* while all eyes turn to him: he is in the **spotlight**.
Lift a *split log* over your head, then throw the *scholar* too: the **strongman**.
Cold *water drops* splash the *visitor* who sits down on the soft, grassy **riverbank**.
Walk the long *road*, *holding meat* for the shrine: the weary **pilgrim**.
On the *roof* sits a rooster with an open *mouth*, turning with the breeze: a **weathervane**.
A *left hand* feels a *towel* woven from plant fibre: cool **linen**.
Tuck a *blanket* over your *elbow* and bend your finger into a **hook**.
Face a *bent cross* signpost and scatter *crumbs* where the sun rises: the **east**.
Under a *slanted cap* a *scorpion* drops its tail and slithers away: a **snake**.
Slide the *door bar* down on his neck, a *standing knife* beside: locked in the **stocks**.
Lay meat on the *altar* and burn it for the gods: a **sacrifice**.
The *magistrate* opens his *mouth* to speak and the whole court kneels: here is the **lord**.
When the *music* soars to its last note, the dancers' *legs* stop: the grand **finale**.
Throw open the *curtains*, the lights flash, the guests jump: a **party**.
A *strong arm* bangs away all day behind *curtains* of sawdust: the carpenter's **workshop**.
At the foot of the *cliff* a *trickle* bubbles out of the rock: a **cliff spring**.
An *arrow landing* next to a *standing knife* marks your journey's end: **arrival**.
A *beetle* climbs over an *archway* dam to hold back the water: the **flood hero**.
